description: This Java class implements an asynchronous command client for the Eclipse Hono framework, enabling sending commands to IoT devices with asynchronous response handling via Vert.x and Proton messaging APIs.

classes.name: AsyncCommandClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of AsyncCommandClient that sends commands asynchronously to devices using Proton messaging.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for its delivery outcome.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a tracing span for sending an async command.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns null; not used in this implementation.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the command request endpoint constant.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address for a device command.

methods.name: getLinkTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the link target address for the sender.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and awaits the outcome.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous command message to a device, optionally with additional properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new AsyncCommandClient instance scoped to a device and tenant.
